data.name: OWGameKit: The Game
data.detailed_description:
OWGameKit: The Game

OWGameKit: The Game is an open-world sandbox that combines exploration, driving, customization, economy, and business management into a single experience. Discover cities, collect vehicles, purchase properties, build businesses, and take part in a wide variety of activities as you create your own journey from poverty to wealth. Rob houses and warehouses, deliver pizzas and advertising flyers, sell drugs to customers across the world, steal export vehicles, or focus on managing your businesses and growing your real estate empire. There is no predefined path to success—you are completely free to decide how you earn money, which activities you pursue, and the lifestyle you want to build.

Exploration

Travel across multiple cities, scenic regions, and hidden locations. Perform spectacular stunt jumps, drive while listening to your favorite music, and enjoy a dynamic open world at your own pace.

Vehicles require fuel to keep running, while speed cameras scattered throughout the world issue fines if you exceed the speed limit. The world is filled with secrets waiting to be discovered, giving you complete freedom to explore without pressure.

Character Customization

Create your character and choose between a male or female appearance at the beginning of the game. Visit clothing stores throughout the city to purchase new outfits and accessories, allowing you to change your style whenever you want to match your personality or try something new.

Vehicles & Customization

Collect, buy, customize, and trade a wide variety of vehicles.

Personalize them with custom lights, wheels, spoilers, bumpers, paint jobs, and many other upgrades to create truly unique vehicles.

Keep your vehicles clean and refueled to maintain them in good condition. You can also steal vehicles from the export list and deliver them to the scrapyard to earn money and XP, adding optional challenges to your sandbox adventure.

Properties & Lifestyle

Buy, manage, and trade a variety of houses while building the lifestyle you want.

Organize your belongings, expand your real estate portfolio, and decide whether to keep or sell your properties depending on your financial situation and long-term goals.

Businesses & Economy

Purchase and manage a variety of businesses to generate passive income over time.

As the owner of a recording studio, you can promote your own artist to perform live at your nightclub and enjoy their music inside the venue. Build nightclubs dedicated to any music genre, including rap, rock, techno, electronic music, and many more.

Own pizzerias to unlock pizza delivery missions and earn additional income. Distribute advertising flyers to increase your nightclub's popularity, attract more customers, and boost your profits. Restore your character's health by eating at restaurants or using vending machines, integrating everyday activities into the sandbox experience.

Missions & Crime

Take part in optional criminal activities inspired by classic heist games.

Rob houses at night and sell the stolen goods to the pawn shop the following day.

Use the pawn shop's van to steal valuable cargo from warehouses and deliver it for profit.

Find customers throughout the world and sell them drugs to earn additional income.

Steal specific vehicles from the export list and deliver them to the scrapyard to earn money and XP.

These activities introduce an optional risk-versus-reward system, allowing you to choose between building a legitimate business empire, living a life of crime, or combining both to create your own path.

Collectibles & Challenges

Discover every stunt jump and collectible hidden throughout the world to earn XP and money.

Complete the full export vehicle collection to unlock additional rewards and long-term progression. These optional objectives encourage exploration, experimentation, and mastery of the sandbox.

Visual Experience

OWGameKit: The Game features high-definition visuals enhanced by a subtle comic book-inspired filter, creating a balanced art style that blends realism with a distinctive visual identity.

Rather than aiming for complete photorealism, the game's visual style combines detailed environments with a light comic-inspired look, giving the world its own unique atmosphere while preserving clarity and immersion.

Story cutscenes are presented in a comic book-style format using illustrated panels to tell key moments of the narrative, adding personality and charm while complementing the game's open-ended sandbox experience.

Global Marketplace

Buy and sell your customized vehicles and properties through a shared online marketplace used by players from around the world. Every listing is synchronized through the game's online service, allowing players to trade asynchronously.

When you list a vehicle or property for sale, it is removed from your single-player world and becomes available on the Global Marketplace. As soon as another player purchases it, ownership is transferred immediately. The purchase price is automatically deducted from the buyer's balance, and the vehicle or property instantly becomes available in their game.

Sellers do not need to be online for transactions to be completed. If one of your listings sells while you are offline, you will receive an in-game notification the next time you launch the game, and the payment will automatically be deposited into your account. If you are playing when the sale occurs, the transaction is processed instantly in real time.

The Global Marketplace complements the game's normal progression rather than replacing it. Brand-new vehicles and properties remain permanently available from dealerships and real estate agencies at their standard prices.

Instead, the marketplace creates a player-driven second-hand economy where you can sell vehicles or houses you no longer need, while other players can purchase used assets, including one-of-a-kind customized vehicles, at prices determined by the community.

This system gives lasting value to everything you own, encourages a healthy in-game economy, and makes every purchase and sale meaningful, even though the game is entirely single-player.

By connecting thousands of individual worlds, every customized vehicle and every purchased property has the potential to become part of a living global economy.

All transactions use only the game's fictional currency. There are no real-money purchases, microtransactions, loot boxes, subscriptions, or pay-to-win mechanics.

Social Network

OWGameKit: The Game features an integrated social network that connects players from around the world through the game's online service.

Every player has a personal profile where they can track their progress, view detailed statistics, browse achievements, and follow their journey throughout the game.

You can also browse a global player list and visit public profiles to view statistics, progression, and other information about players across the community.

Your own profile includes a private list of your Steam friends who own the game, allowing you to compare their progress and statistics. This friends list is visible only to you and cannot be seen by other players.

If you wish, you can donate in-game money to any player in the world, whether they are a friend or a complete stranger. All donations use only in-game currency, with no real-money transactions involved.

This system creates a persistent global community where you can follow the progress of other players, compare statistics, and interact with the game's economy and community while keeping the core experience entirely focused on single-player gameplay.

A Living World That Keeps Growing

OWGameKit: The Game is currently in Early Access, allowing players to jump into the experience today instead of waiting for the final release. This stage also gives the community an opportunity to provide feedback, helping us refine mechanics, balance gameplay systems, and introduce meaningful improvements before the official launch.

Throughout Early Access, the game will continue to receive new gameplay systems, vehicles, properties, businesses, activities, features, optimizations, and quality-of-life improvements, all shaped by ongoing development and community feedback.

However, the release of Version 1.0 will not mark the end of development. OWGameKit: The Game is designed as a continuously evolving sandbox platform that will keep expanding with new content and features for many years to come.

Rather than creating sequels, our goal is to continuously expand this world with new mechanics, activities, and possibilities. In the future, entirely new cities will be introduced as expansions, each offering its own identity, atmosphere, architecture, and style. Players will be able to purchase homes and properties across multiple cities, build a real estate portfolio spanning different regions, and freely relocate whenever they want a fresh experience or a setting that better suits their preferred lifestyle.

Our goal is not to recreate every city in the world, but to offer a carefully curated collection of locations inspired by different cultures, landscapes, and urban environments, combining the best aspects of each into a single, ever-growing sandbox experience.

About the Framework

OWGameKit: The Game was created by DarkDreamStudio using OWGameKit, a complete open-world game framework designed to help developers build sandbox games featuring exploration, driving, customization, economy systems, businesses, missions, and much more.

While this game showcases the capabilities of OWGameKit, some assets, music, models, or gameplay features presented in the game may not be included with the framework itself, giving developers complete freedom to create their own content, mechanics, and worlds.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, OWGameKit provides a powerful foundation that significantly reduces development time. Customize existing systems, create entirely new mechanics, import your own assets, and build unique commercial or personal projects without starting from scratch.

Share Your Feedback

Your feedback helps shape the future of both OWGameKit: The Game and OWGameKit.

Constructive suggestions, bug reports, feature requests, and new ideas are always welcome. Every piece of feedback is carefully read and considered for future updates.

By playing the game and sharing your thoughts, you'll help expand this sandbox world while supporting the continued development of new content, improvements, and tools that benefit both players and developers.

data.short_description: OWGameKit: The Game is a relaxing open-world sandbox with no combat, where you explore, collect vehicles, customize properties, and create your own lifestyle. Discover locations, take part in optional activities, and shape the world at your own pace.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Estonian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Hindi, Lithuanian, Czech
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 TI 4GB / AMD Radeon RX 560 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2.5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 6 GB / AMD RX 5700 XT 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2.5 GB available space
